description: ADCOS Intent object: a machine-readable request describing what connectivity is desired rather than how to obtain it (spec/architecture.md §6.9; LOCK-019). Constraint metrics are deliberately open strings, not an enum: intent vocabulary evolves additively and future metrics must not require schema changes. Normalization, hard/soft preferences, and unsupported-constraint failure semantics are owned by WORK-009.

constraints.description: Connectivity constraints (e.g. bandwidth >= 20 Mbps, latency <= 30 ms, availability >= 99.9%, energy_cost <= threshold, local_breakout = preferred, privacy = end_to_end). Metric names are open vocabulary; routing/adapter implementations determine how to satisfy them.

metric.description: Constraint metric name (open vocabulary; examples from architecture §6.9).

title: ADCOS Intent
